_README: INSTANCE ESTATE CONFIG — your estate's knowledge, private to this repository.
This is the middle of three levels (see systems/config.md):
framework  — systems/meta-os.config.schema.json : valid keys + defaults, ZERO values, public
instance   — THIS FILE, at the repository root beside .claude/CLAUDE.md : estate knowledge, private
deployment — the dashboard's instance.config.json : where the instance is, auth, CORS, dataDir
Keeping estate knowledge here (not in the dashboard's config) is what lets a skill or
a sync script read your estate with the dashboard uninstalled.
Every key but `instance` is OPTIONAL. Delete the rest and you get default behaviour:
this repository's own memory/{raw,wiki,output} as the sole canon root, plus vaults/* as
federated mounts. Nothing here is required to start.
Replace the ${...} placeholders below with your own paths, or delete what you don't use.
A deployment may override any of these keys; this file supplies the defaults.
Keys:
instance   — written by scripts/bootstrap.sh: this instance's name, the date it was
instantiated, and the framework commit whose instance-template/ was copied
in. scripts/upgrade.sh diffs the template from that commit to report what
changed since; your instantiated copies are yours and are never rewritten.
vars       — reusable prefixes: ${name} expands in any value here and in a projects/*.md
'path:', so moving your checkout is a one-line change.
backlogs   — one entry per space you track; 'path' is the space directory of a per-item
backlog, or a legacy backlog.json.
memory     — OMIT the whole block for the default topology. 'roots' ARE the
raw->wiki->output pipeline (layout: flat | tier/project | project/tier);
'federated' mounts are navigation only, never canon; a dangling path is
skipped and reported, never fatal.
